summary: Blue Chip Capital Group Inc. (BCCG) filed an 8-K reporting that FINRA processed a Form 211 submitted by broker-dealer Glendale Securities, Inc. under FINRA Rule 6432 and Rule 15c2-11. This allows Glendale to initiate priced quotations on OTC Link ATS with a bid of $0.3500 and ask of $0.6500. FINRA explicitly disclaims approval of the security or submission. No special-situation event (e.g., merger, tender, restructuring) is disclosed. This is a routine regulatory step enabling trading in the company's stock. What to watch: whether actual trading volume and price discovery develop; no risk-arb angle.
